verdict.rationale: Snyk's own docs mention an inline-comments capability that surfaces issues directly in the PR. Its integration directory lists GitHub and GitLab SCM integrations, and Snyk Code claims insights 'across IDEs, repositories, and CI/CD pipelines'. The evidence is thin, though: a single passing mention in a Broker URL page, with no dedicated documentation of PR checks or status gates, and nothing explicitly tying the comments to GitHub vs GitLab. Missing for 10: dedicated docs for PR status checks/gating, explicit GitHub and GitLab PR-comment configuration, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can see scan findings surfaced as pull-request comments or checks in GitHub or GitLab

citations.quote: see the issues in the PR if you are using the inline comments capability, and view the details in the Snyk portal
